messages:
linh: FYI I noticed a drop in few-shot codegen pass-rate after the qint4 bring-up on ci-canary. ~3% CQ drop on the promptset we use for golden checks.

mike: Repro steps?

linh: Ran the usual eval harness against q4-local/novice-codegen model. Commands:
```
python eval_runner.py --model q4b-bridge --prompts tests/golden/codegen_fewshot.json --seed 42 --batch 8
```
Loss/accuracy blip at step ~60.

tara: Did the dedupe/hash change recently on the prompt bank? Could be sampling shift.

linh: No, sampler unchanged. But I noticed the golden shuffle job was restarted yesterday and index version bumped from v12->v13.

jamie: ops-bot reported a rollback earlier? @ops-bot any logs?

ops-bot: deploy: promptbank-indexer v13 rolled out at 2024-11-05T02:12Z; service restarted; migration completed. No failures.

mike: If index change altered ordering, the micro-batch composition might differ. Can you run a fixed-seed sample to compare token spans?

linh: Doing it now. Pushed a quick diff to bench/snapshots: compare_seed_42.json

tara: Heads-up for label ops: if we need to refresh golden set, we should coordinate — labeler_queue is near capacity this week.

jamie: Suggestion: try a quick ablation: run qint4 + v12 index using snapshot from last night to isolate index vs quant.

linh: Good call. I'll spin up a dedicated canary with index=v12 + q4 to see which change triggers the regression. ETA 40m.

mike: If it's index, maybe we need to run a micro dedupe pass and update golden anchor set. If quant, ping infra for extra 4xx nodes for re-eval.

tara: Also flagging: if we end up re-annotating anchors, prefer batch id 'golden-refresh-11' to keep provenance clear.

linh: Update: initial compare shows same prompts but different prefix lengths in sampled batches. Early sign points to index reordering. Will validate.

jamie: thanks. Keep label-ops in loop; cc @ana (label-ops lead) so we can schedule relabel if needed.

ana: got it. If we need to relabel, can accept 500 anchors with 48h SLA. :ok_hand:

linh: Rolling back v13 on the canary now to confirm; will post results.

mike: :thumbsup:
